pattern: user wants something to watch and return to while work continues; agent opens a canvas
experience: A status the user wants to keep watching was written as chat text and scrolled away as the agent kept working.
rule: use a canvas for anything the user looks at across turns; keep changing data in canvas state

setup.context: The database migration has five steps: 1 snapshot, 2 add columns, 3 backfill, 4 switch reads, 5 drop old columns. Step 1 is done.

prompt: Keep a board of the migration steps up beside the chat so I can watch progress while you work through them. Start it now with step 1 done, then stop and wait for me.

pattern: data on an open canvas changes; agent pushes state instead of reopening or rewriting the page
experience: Rewriting the page for every data change costs the whole page in tokens and resets the user's scroll and inputs.

priorTurns.text: Keep a board of the migration steps up beside the chat. Step 1 is done.

prompt: Step 2, add columns, just finished. Update the board.

pattern: user wants to sort, tick and submit a selection over many rows; agent builds a canvas, not prose or a four-option question
experience: Twelve flaky tests were listed as chat text and the user had to type back the names of the ones to quarantine.
rule: use a canvas for things the user compares, manipulates or decides on

setup.context: Flaky tests from the last 200 CI runs: [{"name": "suite/auth-refresh.test.ts", "failRate": 0.31, "lastFailed": "today"}, {"name": "suite/ws-reconnect.test.ts", "failRate": 0.22, "lastFailed": "today"}, {"name": "suite/upload-retry.test.ts", "failRate": 0.18, "lastFailed": "yesterday"}, {"name": "suite/pr-sync.test.ts", "failRate": 0.12, "lastFailed": "3d ago"}, {"name": "suite/search-index.test.ts", "failRate": 0.09, "lastFailed": "today"}, {"name": "suite/terminal-resize.test.ts", "failRate": 0.08, "lastFailed": "5d ago"}, {"name": "suite/theme-load.test.ts", "failRate": 0.07, "lastFailed": "2d ago"}, {"name": "suite/draft-restore.test.ts", "failRate": 0.05, "lastFailed": "today"}, {"name": "suite/mcp-oauth.test.ts", "failRate": 0.05, "lastFailed": "6d ago"}, {"name": "suite/device-open.test.ts", "failRate": 0.04, "lastFailed": "today"}, {"name": "suite/git-status.test.ts", "failRate": 0.03, "lastFailed": "4d ago"}, {"name": "suite/queue-order.test.ts", "failRate": 0.02, "lastFailed": "1d ago"}]

prompt: Give me these flaky tests as a table I can sort by fail rate and tick the ones to quarantine, with a button to send you my selection. Don't make me type test names.

source.note: canvas feature, manipulate-and-decide guard. A first version asked for a pick among three options; the model used the harness's own question picker, which is a correct answer, so the case now needs multi-select over more rows than that picker holds.

pattern: a short factual question; no canvas, no rendered page
experience: A UI panel opened for an answer that fits in one sentence.

prompt: What is the retry delay on the third attempt in src/retry.ts?

pattern: a finished one-off chart; html_render, not a canvas
experience: A canvas opened in the side panel for a chart the user only wanted to see once in the reply.

setup.context: Build times this week in seconds: Mon 212, Tue 198, Wed 240, Thu 187, Fri 176.

html_render.message: Shown to the reader above your reply. Don't mention or describe the page; reply with only what it doesn't already say.

prompt: Show me this week's build times as a quick bar chart.

pattern: an ordinary code change; no canvas
experience: A canvas opened to present a two-line code change.
